﻿# Fix Maven Compilation Failure: snakeyaml 1.17 -> 2.0

## Context

Project `polyglot-maven` (by takari) has a **COMPILATION_FAILURE** after a dependency upgrade bot bumped
`org.yaml:snakeyaml` from `1.17` to `2.0` (major update).

Reference PR: https://github.com/takari/polyglot-maven/pull/260

## Your Task

The source code is in `/polyglot-maven`. Fix all compilation errors so that `mvn compile` succeeds.
I'll analyze the compilation failure caused by the snakeyaml upgrade and fix it. Let me start by understanding the project structure and the compilation errors.

arguments.description: Run Maven compile to see compilation errors

steps.message:
The snakeyaml 1.17 -> 2.0 upgrade compilation issues have been fixed. Here's a summary of the changes:

## Summary of Changes

The snakeyaml 2.0 upgrade introduced breaking API changes in the `Constructor` and `Representer` classes:

### Files Modified:

**1. `polyglot-yaml/src/main/java/org/sonatype/maven/polyglot/yaml/ModelConstructor.java`**
- Added import: `org.yaml.snakeyaml.LoaderOptions`
- Changed constructor from `super(Model.class)` to `super(Model.class, new LoaderOptions())`

**2. `polyglot-yaml/src/main/java/org/sonatype/maven/polyglot/yaml/ModelRepresenter.java`**
- Added import: `org.yaml.snakeyaml.DumperOptions`
- Removed import: `java.beans.IntrospectionException`
- Changed constructor from `this.representers.put(...)` to `super(new DumperOptions()); this.representers.put(...)`
- Removed `throws IntrospectionException` from `getProperties()` method
- Removed `throws IntrospectionException` from `sortTypeWithOrder()` method

**3. `polyglot-yaml/src/main/java/org/sonatype/maven/polyglot/yaml/YamlModelReader.java`**
- Changed `new Representer()` to `new Representer(new DumperOptions())`

### Note on polyglot-ruby module

The `polyglot-ruby` module still fails to build, but this is a **pre-existing, unrelated issue** with Ruby gems dependency resolution (virtus gem version range `[1.0,1.99999]` has no available versions). This issue is not caused by the snakeyaml upgrade.
